title: Turn feedback into requirements
summary: Identify feedback themes and user impact, then consolidate a traceable requirements list with questions to clarify.
inputs: Authorized feedback and tickets with timestamps and sources
Product and user segments, known issues and recent changes
Existing requirements repository and requirement links
outputs: Feedback themes and user tasks retaining original evidence
Deduplicated requirements list and impact scope
Validation suggestions and clarification questions without development schedule commitments

steps.prompt: Analyze this authorized feedback batch. Feedback records, sources and timestamps: [paste]; product and user segments: [fill in]; known issues and recent changes: [fill in]. Group themes by user context, goal, obstacle and impact. Retain original evidence and contradictory feedback, and describe sample coverage and missing information. Suggest verifiable improvements without promising a development schedule.
steps.handoff: I will check themes against the original records and pass confirmed themes and evidence to Feature Request Tracker.

steps.prompt: Turn the following reviewed feedback themes and original evidence into a requirements list. Themes and evidence: [paste]; existing requirements repository: [provide authorized records]; customer and product segments: [fill in]. Merge duplicate requests and link existing requirements, retaining specific problem contexts, impact scope and clarification questions. Separate requirement facts from prioritization suggestions. Do not promise a schedule on behalf of the product owner or modify the requirements repository.
steps.handoff: The product owner and I will review requirements and verify missing details before deciding priorities and whether to add records.
